rules.text: Most items can be returned within 30 days of delivery if in original, undamaged condition.
rules.quote: We accept returns for most items within 30 days of delivery. The item(s) must be in its original, undamaged condition.

rules.text: Mattresses come with a 100-night free trial for returns.
rules.quote: Every mattress comes with a 100-night free trial. If you don't love your new mattress within the first 100 nights, you can arrange a return for free to store credit, or to your original payment method for a fee ranging from $49-$99.
rules.reviewNote: The summary omits that returns to the original payment method incur a fee, while store credit returns are free. The quote specifies this important condition.

rules.text: Mattress toppers, crib mattresses, air mattresses, and open box mattresses are excluded from the mattress return policy.
rules.quote: This excludes Mattress Toppers, Crib Mattresses, Air Mattresses, and Open Box Mattresses.

rules.text: Items purchased between November 1 and December 31 can be returned until January 31.
rules.quote: For all items purchased between November 1 and December 31 (except Appliances as described above), the deadline to return them is extended until January 31.
rules.reviewNote: The summary omits that appliances are excluded from the extended return window, which is specified in the quote.

rules.text: Mattress returns to original payment method may incur a fee ranging from $49-$99; store credit returns are free.
rules.quote: If you don't love your new mattress within the first 100 nights, you can arrange a return for free to store credit, or to your original payment method for a fee ranging from $49-$99.

rules.text: Refunds to original payment method take 3-5 business days after refund initiation; store credit refunds take 24 hours from initiation.
rules.quote: For store credit, this takes 24 hours from initiation, and 3-5 business days for refunds to the original payment method.
